projects.title: Sahaayak
bullets: Built an Android personal-safety app in Kotlin that reads sensor and microphone data to flag risk in real time.
Wired the risk model to auto-trigger SMS alerts, location sharing, and an alarm, integrating on-device detection with everyday phone features.

projects.title: Portfolio

leadership.title: Peer Reviewer
bullets: After a safety-app teammate's sensor logic broke silently on a classmate's device, started requiring test coverage before merging Android changes.
Reviews classmates' Android pull requests, walking newer students through why an untested sensor edge case can fail only on certain phones.
